subject: GENERATE statement
notes: Format: GENERATE {data-name-1 | report-name-1} (cite.py --check 14.9.16.2 "GENERATE" OK). The grammar parses one operand, `GENERATE reportGroupReference` = cobolWord [(IN|OF) reportName]. The optional qualifier is SR1's "It may be qualified by a report-name". BindGenerate tells the two alternatives apart by resolution. An unqualified name that resolves to a report is report-name-1 (summary reporting); otherwise it resolves through ReportGroupResolution to a report group (data-name-1). A name that matches neither is COBOL1757. Both alternatives were compiled and run in probe out/probe/generate/g1.cob (pinned cobol.exe, --std 2023): `GENERATE DE-1` and `GENERATE R-1`. The data-name alternative is also exercised by conformance:cases/14.9.49-USE/pb365_report_group_qualified and 85/pb365_report_group_qualified_85, which include the qualified form. No spec-derived test exercises the report-name alternative, so test-ref is left empty. || editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (Report Writer is present in every edition; the 2023 Annex E lists no change to GENERATE)
